preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 100000 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Length of each string S is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i] in ['0', '1'] for S in test_cases for i in range(len(S)))
preconditions.description: Each character in string S is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['WIN', 'LOSE'] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is either 'WIN' or 'LOSE'.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i] == 'WIN' if any(S[j] == '1' for j in range(len(S))) else output[i] == 'LOSE') for i, S in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is 'WIN' if there is at least one '1' in the string S, otherwise 'LOSE'.
